title: Thuflep/SOLEP : Initial Experience and Results of Prostate Laser Enucleation With Thulium-fiber Laser (TFL)
brief_summary: Thuflep TLF: initial experience and results of prostate laser enucleation with fibrous thulium laser (TLF)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients superior or equal to 18 years old
* Benign Prostate Hypertrophy ( more than 30cc.)
* Indication to surgical treatment
* No contraindication for surgery
* No opposition to participating in the study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Evidence of urethral stenosis
* Evidence of a bladder tumour
* Evidence of prostate cancer known or confirmed by prostate biopsies if suspected
* Known neurological bladder
* Refusal to participate
study_population: all patients treated at clinique saint hilaire Rouen with Thuflep, who consent
